definitions: To make a desperate attempt to find support or a solution in a hopeless situation, even if the chances of success are very small.
To resort to weak or illogical arguments or methods when all else has failed.
examples: He was grasping at straws trying to prove his innocence.
Her business was failing, and she was grasping at straws to save it.
The lawyer's last argument was clearly grasping at straws.
